name: Conjunto de carga térmica principal y protecciones de la Forja

physicalAnchors.assemblyRole: industrial thermal load hearth and protection assembly

mustPreserve: heavy industrial hearth and thermal load silhouette from primary reference
thermal demand legible through heating elements and material temperature response
thick high-current conductors and ceramic standoff insulators
protection and fuse assembly attached to real service branches
pale stone plinths, dark steel fittings and aged copper conductors
dormant state with cold hearth and inactive conductors
energized state with physical heat/glow localized to heating elements without permanent global neon
trade-off relationship between industrial thermal demand and irrigation allocation
mayResolve: internal heating coil winding, terminal connectors and thermal shielding not defined in references
mounting bracket and maintenance access details
exact fuse cartridge retention clip and trip indicator geometry
runtime mesh segmentation, material slots and pivot hierarchy
exact dimensions after measurement against the accepted greybox runtime
forbidden: magical fantasy forge or lava cavern redesign
permanent blue/red neon glow as a substitute for electrical state
random steam/pipe clutter without electrical function
sparks/particles disconnected from physical load and protection state
invented symbols, lore or electrical behavior
redesign of validated topology, branch consequences or protection behavior
free text-to-3D redesign that departs from the primary hearth reference
Meshy or Tripo use without the required HUMAN_GATE
approvalNote: Approved for the adapt reference-pack gate only. This pack records repo-native visual anchors and does not auto-approve the final hero design, modeling, provider use or canonical GLB; final modeling remains blocked until Sol verifies the reference comparison and runtime constraints.

referenceAudit.primaryRationale: prop_forge_hearth_off.png is the repo-native reference that most directly defines the thermal load hearth silhouette; the supporting references provide on-state thermal response, hanging fuse architecture, and industrial room context.
